# dokploy_project (Data Source)

Fetches a single project from Dokploy by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The project name to look up. Mutually exclusive with project_id.
- `project_id` (String) The project ID to look up. Mutually exclusive with name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the project.
- `description` (String) The description of the project.
- `environments` (Attributes List) List of environments in the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the project (same as project_id).
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID the project belongs to.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) The description of the environment.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the environment.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default environment.
- `name` (String) The name of the environment.
